body.statement: Derive an explicit closed-form \(r_\star(n,d,K)\), including every logarithmic, transition, and saturation branch, construct the total statistically computable estimator \(\widehat V_\star\) with the finite representation and evaluation bound in \(\mathrm{def{:}frontier\text{-}estimator\text{-}handle}\), and prove with absolute constants \(0<c<C<\infty\) that \(c r_\star(n,d,K)\le R(n,d,K)\le\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{d,K}}E_{P^n}[(\widehat V_\star-V^\star(P))^2]\le C r_\star(n,d,K)\) for every \(n,d,K\); use the evaluated rate to characterize exactly when \(R(n,d_n,K_n)\to0\) for arbitrary dimension sequences.
body.justification: The evaluated joint frontier, together with an auditable finite estimator rather than an unevaluated optimization, is the theorem-level kernel promised by the topic.
body.gap: No published comparator supplies both sides of this full-class jointly growing \(d,K\) risk. The accepted \(K=2\) result is only a cited boundary condition; the new work begins with the many-arm grouping transfer and the \(K\)-uniform certificate.
body.consumer: The result becomes the unrestricted attainable-value benchmark against which multi-arm causal forests and observational treatment-targeting methods can report the statistical price of expanding menus.

obligation.what_is_open: The explicit sharp risk scale and total attaining estimator in the intermediate region \(2<K<d^2\), together with the necessary-and-sufficient consistency boundary for arbitrary \(d_n,K_n\).
obligation.obstruction: The fixed-sample winner lower bound and empirical upper bound have different orders in part of the intermediate region. Closing that gap requires the unresolved dimension-uniform certificate, followed by absolute-constant localization and fixed-sample aggregation. The current core contains no result that turns the exact local identities into a sharper full-class estimator or a matching same-class converse.
obligation.attempted: The empirical estimator was optimized without unknown nuisance inputs, the centered-winner mixture was evaluated exactly including saturation, the one-group and large-menu regions were matched, and the binary experiment was transferred by a parameter-free channel. These produce an explicit honest bracket but not equality of its two scales in the central region.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved fixed-sample bracket is
\[
 c\min\!\left\{1,\frac{\max\{d/\log(ed),\ dK\log(1+\sqrt{K/d})\}}{n}\right\}
 \leq R(n,d,K)
 \leq C\min\!\left\{1,\frac{dK\log(eK)}n\right\}.
\]
It is sharp for \(K\geq d^2\), is sharp for \(d=1\), and combines with the accepted binary frontier on \(K=2\).  The total empirical estimator attains the displayed upper bound, and the parametric-MSE condition is exactly bounded \((d_n)\) and bounded \((K_n)\).  The explicit intermediate-region rate, an attaining estimator at that sharper rate, and the necessary-and-sufficient general consistency condition remain unresolved because the dimension-uniform certificate has not been constructed.
